hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Custom-curve hook implementing 1:1 ETH/phiEth swapping. The beforeSwap hook takes the full input amount from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert between ETH and phiEth, settles the output, and returns a full delta to bypass concentrated liquidity. Direct liquidity additions always revert. Only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee can use this hook.
